name: B10-0389/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion, not changing any law. It responds to the European Commission's review of the common fisheries policy, the EU rules on fishing. It says the policy's goals are still right but have not been met: fish stocks are not recovering, too many boats still exist, and the landing obligation has not changed fishing habits. It asks for better enforcement, more support for small-scale coastal fishing, fairer allocation of fishing quotas, clearer labelling of seafood, and a new overarching EU oceans law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** Fishers, coastal communities, seafood traders and consumers across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission; they decide whether to act.
